title: DECISION: verify_strict over verify for Ed25519
description: verify_did_sig calls ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey::verify_strict rather than verify. verify_strict performs cofactor multiplication and rejects signatures that verify only due to small-order or non-canonical key/signature encodings — attacks that verify() allows. This hardens the implementation against the Chalkias et al. Ed25519 malleability class (cofactor-related signature forgeries and identity-point attacks). Given that the DID URL and signature both arrive over an untrusted NNTP connection, using the stricter check is the correct default.
